clause: Native spot-color posture + branded library adapter (Pantone) [STU-COL-020,STU-COL-021]

scope.summary: Native spot color is first-class: StudioSwatch(spot) ([STU-COL-007]) — a named separation ink with optional Lab definition, tint control, and separation/preview behavior — is a native Studio primitive that ships and functions with NO external library and NO license ([STU-OVR-002]); spot inks separate, proof, overprint, and appear in Ink Manager/Separations Preview regardless of any branded library. Branded spot libraries (Pantone, DIC, HKS, Focoltone, Trumatch, ANPA, Toyo, and equivalents) are LICENSE-GATED EXTERNAL DATA and MUST be modeled as an OPTIONAL adapter (a StudioModelAdapter/import path that populates native StudioSwatch(spot) entries), never a required bundled dependency or a Studio-owned name. Loading a branded book maps its inks onto native spot swatches with library-defined Lab/CMYK values; absence of the adapter degrades only branded-name lookup, never spot-color functionality. Operator adapter-load surface + model command.
acceptance_criteria: native spot first-class with no library/license; branded books optional adapter populating native spots; graceful degrade
expected_tests: live: native StudioSwatch(spot) separates/proofs/overprints/appears in ink-manager+separations with NO library loaded
test: branded book adapter maps inks onto native spot swatches (Lab/CMYK); absent adapter degrades only name lookup, spot functionality intact

target_entries: Studio / Color / Spot colors & branded libraries

risk_if_missed: Branded library bundled as hard dependency (license risk) or spot color unusable without it.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
